comparison_09198_to_09205.interpretation: Primary set-based Recall/Precision can only change on the membership-change queries; rank-only reorder is metric-neutral.

scientific_notes: Official 0.920544597 is verified from the supplied CodaBench scoring_result_09205.zip.
The original handoff scripts use train/warmup answer matching only as an oracle diagnostic. The corrected root-patch builders remove all label/oracle loading and perform structural validation only.
The README statement '1819.92 correct queries' should not be treated as a literal count; recall is a macro metric and the supplied score file reports recall/precision only.
The original '109 oracle queries' diagnostic is not equivalent to the official 1977-unseen scoring population and must not be used for model selection.
